postRcChangeGroups.summary: Recorded the exact published RC2 source, timestamp, archive digest, live observation window, and post-publication change ledger; synchronized public release status, strengthened immutable RC1/RC2 source-lock validation, corrected stable-release groundwork to use RC2 as the direct identity baseline, hardened the stable gate so any compatibility-critical finding requires a new RC even after the individual report is resolved, and made release validators explicitly safe across the planned RC2-to-stable maturity transition.
Resolved future stable-promotion decisions for the reviewed ru-Cyrl, ja-Kana, and ko-Hang month profiles while leaving the published RC2 registries draft and leaving weekday aliases unreviewed.

Hardened repository automation, dependency/security maintenance, release concurrency, and branch housekeeping, then removed the final superseded branch; no calendar, registry, conversion, or RC2 release semantics changed.

Audited all reader-facing localized month and weekday tables, added Georgian and Armenian introductions without inventing unreviewed aliases, corrected language-specific wording, removed a stale hard-coded Pages language count, and strengthened multilingual/public-page validation; canonical names and published RC2 identity remained unchanged.
